I am a PhD candidate in Education Policy at the University of Virginia and an Institute of Education Sciences (IES) pre-doctoral fellow. My research uses and develops methods in causal inference and measurement science to evaluate emerging technologies in education. I focus on two questions: Do these technologies improve student learning, and can we trust the measures used to evaluate them?
